Chapter 04 / 11ARCHITECTURE

One plan. Distinct responsibilities.

The coordinator decomposes work, delegates bounded tasks, checks results and decides what happens next. Specialists execute within their assigned scope.

Own the workflow

Keep routing, acceptance criteria and stopping decisions in the coordinator. A search agent returns evidence; it does not silently redefine the user’s goal.

Parallelize independent work

Search different APIs in parallel, then join the results. If analysis depends on retrieved documents, wait for those inputs. Extra agents increase cost and coordination overhead.

Practice

What input is missing? Who owns the next action? What evidence must survive? Explain the failure before choosing a component.
